facet_counts.description: Facet value counts for the search results.

found.description: Total number of documents matching the query.

found_docs.description: Total number of documents found before grouping.

search_time_ms.description: Time taken for the search in milliseconds.

out_of.description: Total number of documents in the collection.

search_cutoff.description: Whether the search was cut off due to time limits.

grouped_hits.description: Array of grouped search result hits when group_by is used.

request_params.description: Parameters used for the search request.

conversation.description: Conversational search response when conversation mode is enabled.

answer.description: Generated answer from the conversation model.

conversation_id.description: ID of the conversation for follow-up queries.
